Jordan / team — quick legal read below after review of Mercato_MSA_redline_v3.docx. Attaching our annotated redline finished in-line (file: Mercato_MSA_Redline_KP_v1.docx).

High-level positions:
- Net Terms: counterproposal = Net 45 (standard) with a 2% early-pay discount to approximate net-30 economics. If sales needs to concede to Net 30, require an escalation approval (Markus).
- Data retention: 7-year export capability is feasible, but we will scope it as "export on reasonable request" plus an addendum on export SLA (we should not commit to continuous storage at customer cost).
- SFTP/EDI: ops can support SFTP delivery; however, EDI ACK SLAs should be scoped to standard processing windows (we cannot guarantee sub-1hr ACK during peak). Recommend drafting an Order Form addendum for the integration scope and SLA table.
- Liability/indemnity redlines: we can accept a capped liability with mutual indemnities; propose $5M cap with carveouts for gross negligence.

Action items for me: consolidated redline (attached), short paragraph to add to order form about integration scope/SLA.
